nativeTupleAdapters.pair: {first,second} corresponds to Rust tuple .0,.1 with order preserved.
nativeTupleAdapters.widthEntry: {name,width} corresponds to Rust (String,u32); ordered duplicates retained.

canonicalUTF8: Replace each complete native String only at the listed text fields by all canonical UTF8 bytes, preserving byte count/order. The native String relation is an external positive premise, not a new UTF8 validator or measured Rust execution.
opaqueFields: All Selected.bytes payloads remain exact native byte Lists, including nonUTF8 bytes, empty payloads, zero and255. Do not decode, hash, validate or normalize digest payloads. Selected format stays opaque text pair.
options: None=null; Some={Some:payload}. None and Some(empty/zero values) stay distinct. Digest Unselected is a separate plain-string variant from Selected(emptyformat/emptybytes).
nativeScalarKinds: Exact native int/bool; no bool/int/str/float coercions. IDs/profile/widths/rawu128 stay integers. All arrays ordered, including repeats.
inputInverse: Canonical UTF8 decode of projected text fields returns the entire original native record, every other field byte-for-byte/structurally unchanged; no computed outputs.
